source.families: Four action-role-shuffled degree1 affine XOR six-bit worlds (5301-5304); four degree2 sparse pairwise conjunction/XOR worlds (5305-5308); four degree3 sparse triple-conjunction/XOR worlds (5309-5312); four degree4 quadruple-conjunction/XOR adversarial negative worlds (5313-5316). Each six-bit action unconditionally flips own hidden role and may flip role-lower hidden sensors via at most TWO additional XOR-summed true monomials per (action,target); all TRUE primary action-target effect functions are sparse (<=3 nonzero terms including constant). Source-private action/sensor permutations SHA256-seeded from 5301-5316, with new WSP79 salt. A degree4 source can be incompatible and must be rejected if supported observations expose contradiction. Six-bit source remains a STRONGLY source-aligned Boolean family, not natural generalization.
source.physical: TWO independently physically charged zero-initialized source-identical 144-action no-reset physical trajectories per world: identical independently paid first96 A actions, then 48 REAL B actions selected via unchanged WSP76 actual charged same-state contrast policy or independently SHA uniform random. 16*2*144=4608 physically paid source action/consequence observations, no reset, teleport, arbitrary-state simulator training queries, hidden role import or evaluator-private label access.
source.heldout: Evaluator ONLY after weights frozen: 64 public binary states×6 public actions=384 source state/action truths/world; primary 4608, negative 1536, 32 independent two-action tasks/world, ≥2880 genuinely never-physically-charged primary input/action outcomes by arithmetic.

writer.prior: For each of six public actions and six causal effect output bits, fixed source-blind dictionary of ALL degree0/1/2/3 conjunction monomials over six public state bits: 1+6+15+20=42 numerical ReLU detectors per public action, total 252 fixed 12-input ReLU hidden units. Physical effect bit is before XOR after. Fixed hypothesis class comprises GF2 XOR of any 0, 1, 2, or 3 monomials from this 42-term dictionary per action/output bit; includes zero function, means at most3 nonzero coefficients. The monomial degree and size of the causal effect polynomial are *discovered via charged observations* not hardcoded from source family. Contains source's 1/2/3-degree primary physics, not degree4 negative.
writer.learning: For each of six public action channels, collect unique source-blind paid (before,action,after) facts in continuous session. Encode the paid state patterns into an observation truth bitmask for each of 42 public terms and each of six effect bits. Enumerate all 0-3 sparse GF2 term combinations in deterministic lexicographic order, testing exact parity against all *charged* action evidence; never query source on an uncharged input. Keep all exactly consistent candidates, never select one solely from evaluator truth. If NONE fit for an action/output bit, mark that output inconsistent and numeric confidence for entire action is NONE. For a query s,a, only mark model CONFIDENT if all charged-consistent sparse candidates predict the same SIX-bit change; otherwise abstain. The canonical lexicographically first consistent sparse GF2 coefficient vector is compiled into actual 6×252 NUMERICAL effect weights; it need not be globally unique, hence the confidence gate. No gradients/backprop in writer.
writer.numeric_forward: Use six-action-conditioned real ReLU monomial detectors, numerical learned coefficient matrix, ReLU integer-parity sawtooth up to 3 monomials per bit, and ReLU XOR for next six bits. ALL cold prediction strictly ReLU numerical weights and biases, no candidate search, GF2 solver, symbolic polynomial evaluator, raw paid ledger or source truth. Confidence of each publicly enumerable 384 state/action identity is compiled into a separate fixed public exact-match ReLU detector with 0/1 numerical learned confidence weights from sparse-hypothesis unanimity on charged evidence ONLY. Report entire parameter and detector cost, including potentially large confidence head.
writer.learning_schedule: At action96 compile source-blind Stage-A canonical numeric coefficients and unanimous-confidence gate, snapshot and compute (but never test-label filter) predicted confident answers. Then acquire exactly48 further PAID no-reset physical actions and compile StageB from compressed/unique paid facts. No protected source. Evaluate Stage-A truly confident correct and StageB retention ONLY after all weight policies frozen. Explicitly report computational overhead and memory; materializing all candidate hypotheses in RAM is not a claim of incremental online efficiency.
writer.negative_behavior: Degree4 source physics is outside model family. Some actions may be inconsistent with all <=3 sparse hypotheses on physically paid evidence and source-blind abstention then should occur. But unresolved aliasing may still yield confidently incorrect negative heldout predictions; frozen max allowed 20/1536. Record bad cases by source seed/action; no post-result widening or threshold change.

limitations: Fixed 6-bit source with 6 public actions and degree<=3 sparse Boolean effect grammar is a very strong hand-coded bias, not source-independent feature creation, higher-dimensional perception, language or AGI.

The offline sparse candidate search is symbolic algebra that writes an executable neural circuit, and an equally capable independent symbolic baseline is expected to tie. Calling it a conventional learned deep neural representation would be incorrect.

All 384 unlabeled state/action input identities can be enumerated for numerical confidence detector construction; not scalable to unknown open worlds. Do not hide classifier head capacity or training-time search CPU.
Only actually paid physical outcome labels enter candidate selection; model predictions on evaluator-private inputs do NOT influence training policy or pass thresholds.
Equal physical action budgets do NOT imply equal information; same-ledger controls separate model capacity from action choice.
Degree4 negative sources may fool the sparse model where observed evidence fails to expose mismatch. Preserve negatives; do not claim universal out-of-distribution safety.
Success in SELFTEST does not prove broad general intelligence, scientific acceptance, or authorize owner-loop, controller, merge or deployment.
